lines.text: God sends an angel before Israel to protect them and bring them to the place He prepared.
If Israel obeys, God will be an enemy to their enemies and bring them into the Amorites' land.
Israel must demolish the nations' gods and smash their sacred stones, and serve the LORD, who will take away poverty.
God sends His terror ahead and sends the locust to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out.
God will drive the nations out little by little and set Israel's borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines.
